name: Barbell bench press
howTo: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width, squeeze your shoulder blades together and unrack.
Lower the bar under control to your mid-chest, elbows at about 45° from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight, keeping your upper back tight.
cues: Shoulder blades pinned back and down
Touch the same spot on your chest every rep
Drive your feet into the floor
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off your chest
Flaring elbows straight out to the sides
Lifting your hips off the bench

name: Incline DB press
howTo: Set the bench to about 30°. Sit back with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Kick the dumbbells up as you lie back and hold them over your upper chest.
Lower them wide and deep until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Press up and slightly in until your arms are straight.
cues: Keep the bench low: 30° hits the upper chest, not the shoulders
Get a deep stretch at the bottom
mistakes: Cutting the range short at the bottom
Clanging the dumbbells together at the top

name: Seated DB shoulder press
howTo: Set the bench upright or one notch back and sit with your back against it.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward, elbows slightly in front of you.
Press straight up until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower under control until the dumbbells are level with your ears or a little lower.
cues: Ribs down, don't arch off the pad
mistakes: Arching the lower back to push the weight
Letting the dumbbells drift behind your head

name: Standing DB shoulder press
howTo: Stand with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower back to shoulder height under control.
cues: Squeeze glutes so your lower back stays neutral
Head moves slightly back to clear the path
mistakes: Leaning back into a standing incline press

name: Cable lateral raise
howTo: Set a cable at hand height or lower. Stand side-on and hold the handle with the far hand.
Start with your hand in front of your hip and a slight bend in the elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side until it's about level with your shoulder.
Lower slowly, letting the cable pull your arm slightly across your body for a stretch.
cues: Lead with the elbow, not the hand
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulder up to your ear

name: DB lateral raise
howTo: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides, elbows slightly bent.
Lean forward very slightly from the hips.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are about level with your shoulders.
Lower slowly to your sides.
cues: Pinkies level with or slightly above thumbs
Pick a weight you can control
mistakes: Going too heavy and cutting the range

name: Overhead cable triceps extension
howTo: Attach a rope to a low or mid pulley. Face away and hold the rope behind your head.
Step forward into a split stance with your elbows pointing forward and up.
Straighten your arms forward and up until they're fully extended.
Let your hands come back behind your head until you feel a deep triceps stretch.
cues: Keep your elbows still: only the forearms move
Chase the stretch at the bottom
mistakes: Turning it into a pullover by moving the upper arm

name: DB overhead triceps extension
howTo: Sit or stand holding one dumbbell with both hands under the top plate, arms overhead.
Keeping your upper arms near your head, lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Go down until you feel a strong stretch in your triceps.
Straighten your arms to lift the dumbbell back overhead.

name: Cable fly (deep stretch)
howTo: Set both pulleys at about shoulder height. Grab a handle in each hand and step forward.
With a slight bend in your elbows, let your arms open until you feel a deep chest stretch.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide hugging arc.
Return slowly to the stretched position.
cues: Fixed elbow bend, like hugging a barrel
mistakes: Turning it into a press by bending the elbows more
Going too heavy to control the stretch

name: DB floor press
howTo: Lie on the floor with knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Lower the dumbbells until your upper arms touch the floor, elbows at about 45°.
Pause briefly with your arms resting on the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Soft touch on the floor, no bounce
mistakes: Slamming the elbows into the floor

name: Feet-elevated push-up
howTo: Put your feet on a bed or chair and your hands on the floor, a little wider than shoulders.
Make a straight line from head to heels and brace your abs.
Lower until your chest is close to the floor.
Push back up to straight arms.
cues: Body stays in one straight line
Add a backpack for weight when it gets easy

name: DB floor fly
howTo: Lie on the floor with knees bent, light dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in the elbows, open your arms out to the sides.
Lower until your upper arms lightly touch the floor.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest in an arc.
cues: Squeeze your chest at the top

name: Lat pulldown
howTo: Sit with your thighs under the pad and grip the bar a little wider than shoulders.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise all the way until your arms are straight and your lats are stretched.
cues: Chest up to meet the bar
mistakes: Leaning far back and rowing it

name: Pull-up
howTo: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip a little wider than shoulders.
Pull your shoulders down, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Go up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way to a dead hang.
cues: Start each rep from a full hang
Drive elbows down to your sides
Use a band for help, or a backpack for load
mistakes: Craning the neck to reach the bar

name: Neutral-grip pull-up
howTo: Grab parallel handles with palms facing each other and hang with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down and back.
Pull until your chin is above the handles.
Lower under control to a full hang.
cues: Use the assisted machine if needed

name: Chest-supported row
howTo: Lie chest-down on an incline bench or the machine pad, a weight in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight and your shoulder blades spread.
Row your elbows back until your hands reach your lower ribs.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
cues: Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top
mistakes: Lifting your chest off the pad to cheat

name: Seated cable row (full stretch)
howTo: Sit at the cable row with feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, holding the handle.
Let your arms and shoulders reach forward for a full stretch, back straight.
Row the handle to your stomach while sitting tall.
Return forward slowly into the stretch.
cues: Reach forward with the shoulders at the start
mistakes: Swinging your torso back and forth

name: One-arm cable row
howTo: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle in one hand, stepping back.
Let your arm reach forward and your shoulder blade move forward for a stretch.
Row your elbow back past your torso.
Return slowly to the stretch, then switch sides after the set.
mistakes: Twisting your torso to move the weight

name: One-arm DB row
howTo: Put one knee and hand on a bench or chair, back flat, dumbbell in the other hand.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down with your shoulder relaxed.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip, elbow close to your side.
Lower to a full stretch, then switch sides after the set.
cues: Pull toward the hip, not the chest
mistakes: Twisting to heave the weight up

name: Band row
howTo: Anchor a band at chest height or loop it around your feet while seated.
Hold the ends with arms straight and a little tension on the band.
Row your elbows back until your hands reach your ribs.
Return slowly until your arms are straight and shoulders reach forward.
cues: Keep tension on the band at the bottom

name: Reverse pec deck
howTo: Sit facing the pec deck pad with the handles set to the rear delt position.
Grab the handles with straight arms at shoulder height.
Sweep your arms back and out until they're in line with your body.
Return slowly until your hands nearly meet.
cues: Lead with the backs of your hands
Keep your chest on the pad
Don't squeeze the shoulder blades hard; it's a shoulder move
mistakes: Bending the elbows more to move more weight

name: DB rear delt fly
howTo: Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, light dumbbells hanging.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are level with your body.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Squeezing with the upper back instead of the shoulders

name: Incline DB curl
howTo: Set a bench to about 45° and lie back with your arms hanging straight down, palms forward.
Keep your upper arms still and behind your body.
Curl the dumbbells up without letting your elbows move forward.
Lower all the way until your arms are fully straight.
cues: Arms hang behind your torso for the stretch

name: DB hammer curl
howTo: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up, keeping your palms facing in.
Lower under control to straight arms.

name: Back squat
howTo: Set the bar on your upper back, step out and stand with feet about shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Take a big breath and brace your abs.
Sit down between your hips, knees tracking over your toes, until your hips are at or below your knees.
Drive up through your whole foot to standing.
mistakes: Chest collapsing forward out of the bottom

name: Goblet squat
howTo: Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest, feet about shoulder width.
Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
Squat down between your knees as low as you can with a flat back.
Stand back up, pushing through your whole foot.
cues: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom
mistakes: Letting the weight pull you forward

name: Romanian deadlift
howTo: Stand holding the bar at hip height, feet hip-width, knees soft.
Push your hips back and let the bar slide down your thighs, back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, usually around mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand up tall.
mistakes: Bending the knees into a squat
Letting the bar drift away from your legs

name: DB Romanian deadlift
howTo: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, feet hip-width, knees soft.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs, back flat.
Go down until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand.

name: Leg press
howTo: Sit in the leg press with your back flat and feet shoulder-width in the middle of the platform.
Release the safeties and lower the platform by bending your knees.
Go as deep as you can without your lower back lifting off the pad.
Press back up without locking your knees hard.
cues: Lower back stays on the pad
mistakes: Hips rolling up at the bottom
Tiny range of motion with a huge weight

name: Heel-elevated goblet squat
howTo: Put your heels on a thick book or plate, feet close together, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Keep your torso upright.
Squat down, letting your knees travel far forward over your toes.
Stand back up.

name: Seated leg curl
howTo: Sit in the machine with the pad above your ankles and the thigh pad locked down.
Lean your torso slightly forward to stretch the hamstrings more.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Let the pad return slowly until your legs are almost straight.
cues: Lean forward a little for more stretch

name: Slider or towel leg curl
howTo: Lie on your back on a smooth floor with your heels on towels or sliders.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels out until your legs are nearly straight, keeping hips up.
Pull your heels back in toward your hips.
cues: Keep your hips up the whole set
Use one leg to make it harder

name: Leg extension
howTo: Sit with the pad on your lower shins and your knees lined up with the machine's pivot.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the pad.
Straighten your legs fully.
Lower slowly until your knees are well bent.
cues: Lean back slightly for more quad stretch
mistakes: Skipping the bottom of the range

name: Sissy squat
howTo: Stand holding a door frame or wall for balance, feet hip-width.
Rise onto the balls of your feet and push your knees forward.
Lean back so there's a straight line from knees to head as you lower.
Go as low as you can control, then push back up.
cues: Straight line from knees to shoulders
Band Spanish squat is an easier option
mistakes: Going deeper than your knees tolerate

name: Standing calf raise (2 s pause)
howTo: Stand in the calf raise machine with the balls of your feet on the edge.
Lower your heels as far as they go and pause for 2 seconds in the stretch.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly back into the stretch.
cues: 2-second pause at the bottom, every rep

name: Single-leg DB calf raise
howTo: Stand on one foot on a step, holding a dumbbell on the same side and a wall with the other hand.
Lower your heel as far as it goes and pause for 2 seconds.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
cues: Hold the wall only for balance
mistakes: Using the wall to pull up

name: Incline barbell or Smith press
howTo: Set the bench to about 30° under the bar. Lie back with your eyes under the bar.
Grip a little wider than shoulders and pull your shoulder blades back.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, just below the collarbones.
Press back up to straight arms.
cues: Bar path slightly back toward your face as you press

name: Machine chest press
howTo: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades against the pad.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

name: Chair dip
howTo: Put your hands on the edge of a sturdy chair behind you, legs out in front.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your back close to the chair.
Push back up to straight arms.
cues: Shoulders down, away from your ears
Bend the knees to make it easier
mistakes: Going so deep your shoulders hurt
Using a chair that can slide

name: Conventional or trap-bar deadlift
howTo: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, feet hip-width. Grip just outside your legs.
Push your hips back, flatten your back and take the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar against your legs.
Lower by pushing your hips back, bar close to your body.
mistakes: Jerking the bar off the floor

name: Hip thrust
howTo: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a padded bar over your hips.
Plant your feet so your shins are vertical at the top.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is flat from shoulders to knees.
Lower your hips under control.
cues: Squeeze your glutes hard at the top
mistakes: Arching the lower back to finish
Feet too far or too close

name: DB hip thrust
howTo: Sit with your upper back against a sofa or bed, a dumbbell resting on your hips.
Plant your feet so your shins will be vertical at the top.
Lift your hips until your body is flat from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly. Do it on one leg when it gets easy.
cues: Squeeze your glutes at the top
Pause for a second at the top

name: Bulgarian split squat
howTo: Stand in front of a bench, holding dumbbells, and rest the top of your back foot on it.
Step your front foot far enough forward that your knee stays over your foot at the bottom.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to stand. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
cues: Most of your weight on the front leg
Lean forward slightly for more glutes
mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench

name: Seated calf raise (pause at bottom)
howTo: Sit in the machine with the pad on your lower thighs and the balls of your feet on the edge.
Lower your heels as far as possible and pause in the stretch.
Push up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly back into the stretch.

name: Bent-knee DB calf raise
howTo: Sit on a chair with the balls of your feet on a book or step and dumbbells on your knees.
Lower your heels as far as they go and pause.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower slowly back into the stretch.
cues: Keep the weights on your knees
mistakes: Weights too light to feel it

name: Hanging leg raise
howTo: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Brace your abs and stop any swinging.
Raise your legs by curling your pelvis up, knees bent or straight.
Lower slowly without swinging.
cues: Curl your pelvis up, don't just lift your legs
Bend your knees to make it easier
mistakes: Only lifting to hip height with an arched back

name: Lying leg raise
howTo: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips or holding something behind your head.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they're vertical, then lift your hips slightly off the floor.
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch.
cues: Bend knees if your back arches
